user_login.format: A string, almost always shaped like an email address.

user_display_name.format: A name string, observed as first and last name joined with a space.

values.ACTIVE: The account is enabled and can sign in.
values.STAGED: The account exists but has not yet been activated.
values.PROVISIONED: The account was created by an admin and is pending activation.
values.RECOVERY: The account is in a password or MFA recovery flow.
values.PASSWORD_EXPIRED: The account's password has expired and must be reset before sign-in.
values.LOCKED_OUT: The account is locked, usually after too many failed sign-in attempts.
values.SUSPENDED: An admin has suspended the account; it cannot sign in.
values.DEPROVISIONED: The account has been deactivated and cannot sign in.

values.ACTIVE_DIRECTORY: An Active Directory instance validates the password.
values.LDAP: An LDAP directory instance validates the password.
values.FEDERATION: A federated identity provider validates the credential; no Okta password exists.
values.SOCIAL: A social or third-party OIDC identity provider validates the credential; no Okta password exists.
values.IMPORT: A hashed password was imported from an external source.

values.OKTA_GROUP: Managed directly in Okta, by static assignment or a group rule.
values.APP_GROUP: Imported from and must be managed within a connected app, such as Active Directory.
values.BUILT_IN: A default group Okta manages; its profile and membership cannot be edited.

app_name.format: A short internal key name, lower case.

app_user_external_id.format: An opaque string the target app assigns.

values.USER: The person was assigned to the app directly.
values.GROUP: The person has the app because a group they belong to is assigned it.

values.STAGED: externalId is not yet set; provisioning is queued.
values.PROVISIONED: Provisioning finished and externalId was assigned.
values.ACTIVE: The assignment is provisioned and the person can use the app.
values.INACTIVE: The assignment is provisioned but the person cannot use the app yet.
values.SUSPENDED: The assignment is disabled; it can be reactivated without a password reset.
values.PENDING: The assignment is provisioned but pending; it becomes ACTIVE once activated.
values.APPROVED: The assignment was created but not yet provisioned; needs manual acknowledgment.
values.REVOKED: The assignment is disabled and waiting for deprovisioning acknowledgment.
values.IMPORTED: The assignment was created from imported data.
values.MATCHED: The imported assignment was matched to an existing app user.
values.UNASSIGNED: The assignment was imported but user-matching was skipped.
values.IMPLICIT: The assignment now uses implicit app assignment rather than an explicit record.
values.DEPROVISIONED: The person was removed by the provisioning operation; externalId is unassigned.

app_credential_username.format: A username string, often an email address.

assignment_sync_outcome.format: One fixed word, observed as success in this deployment.

values.success: The row's own sync or provisioning step completed without error; not the Okta AppUserStatus.

change_action.format: One fixed word, observed as modified on every row in this deployment.

values.modified: The generic change tag's action value; does not vary in the observed data.

change_type_tag.format: One fixed word, observed as filesystem on every row in this deployment.

values.filesystem: The generic change tag's category value; does not describe an app assignment and looks like an uncustomized default.

change_object_category.format: One fixed word, observed as user on every row in this deployment.

values.user: The generic change tag says the object that changed is a user.

change_object_attrs.format: One fixed word, observed as status on every row in this deployment.

values.status: The generic change tag says the assignment's status attribute changed.

values.Okta: A fixed literal naming the vendor product, for CIM tagging.

values.ACTIVE: The app instance is active and available to be assigned and used.
values.INACTIVE: The app instance is deactivated; assignments are not provisioned.
values.DELETED: The app instance has been deleted.

values.AUTO_LOGIN: Secure Web Authentication (SWA): Okta fills in a login form it does not control.
values.BASIC_AUTH: SWA using HTTP Basic Authentication with the Okta Browser Plugin.
values.BROWSER_PLUGIN: SWA with the Okta Browser Plugin filling the form.
values.SAML_1_1: Federated authentication with SAML 1.1 WebSSO; not supported for custom apps.
values.SECURE_PASSWORD_STORE: SWA with a POSTed form; no plugin required.
values.WS_FEDERATION: Federated authentication with the WS-Federation passive requestor profile.

app_features.format: A multivalue list of fixed words from a large enabled-features catalog (44 literals in the schema); not enumerated here, see the cite for the full list.

examples.note: one literal from a features{} multivalue field

app_universal_logout_status.format: One fixed word from ApplicationUniversalLogout's status enum.

values.ENABLED: Universal Logout is enabled; users are signed out of the app when Okta or an admin initiates logout.
values.DISABLED: Universal Logout is disabled for this app.
values.UNSUPPORTED: The app does not support Universal Logout.

app_credential_scheme.format: One fixed word from ApplicationCredentialsScheme; present only for BASIC_AUTH, BROWSER_PLUGIN or SECURE_PASSWORD_STORE apps.

values.ADMIN_SETS_CREDENTIALS: An admin sets both the username and password.
values.EDIT_PASSWORD_ONLY: An admin sets the username; the user sets the password.
values.EDIT_USERNAME_AND_PASSWORD: The user sets both the username and password.
values.EXTERNAL_PASSWORD_SYNC: An admin sets the username; the password is kept the same as the user's Okta password.
values.SHARED_USERNAME_AND_PASSWORD: All users share one username and password set by the admin.

app_username_template.format: An Okta Expression Language mapping expression; ${source.login} is the built-in default.

values.BUILT_IN: One of Okta's built-in mapping expressions is used.
values.CUSTOM: A custom mapping expression is used.

values.DISABLED: Entitlement management is disabled for the app.
values.DISABLING: Entitlement management was enabled and is now being disabled.
values.ENABLED: Entitlement management is enabled for the app.
values.ENABLING: Entitlement management was disabled and is now being enabled.
values.NONE: Entitlement management was never opted into for the app.

values.DISABLED: The default state; the app does not require a VPN notice.
values.ANYWHERE: The VPN notice shows regardless of the client's IP.
values.ON_NETWORK: The VPN notice shows only when the client IP matches the configured gateway IPs.
values.OFF_NETWORK: The VPN notice shows only when the client IP does not match the configured gateway IPs.
values.ZONE: The VPN notice is scoped to a configured network zone.

group_object_class.format: A single-element array naming the group's profile shape.

values.okta:user_group: An Okta-native group; its profile is OktaUserGroupProfile (name, description).
values.okta:windows_security_principal: A group imported from Active Directory; its profile is OktaActiveDirectoryGroupProfile.

ad_windows_group_type.format: A Windows AD group category string.

ad_group_scope.format: A Windows AD group scope string.

ad_object_sid.format: A Windows security identifier (SID), S-1-... form.
